name: LoneStarOracle
instructions_text: LoneStarOracle: 71 independent pay-per-call data services behind one catalog — macro/labor/energy, equities and smart-money flow, crypto due diligence, geopolitical/compliance risk, and contract audits. The unified spec's root server is the /api gateway, which proxies every service payment-gated (each op also names its canonical <service>.lonestaroracle.xyz host via x-direct-url). Tier markers: ops with authMode=free answer ungated (their descriptions say so); payment ops settle per call via x402 USDC on Base, $0.001-$2.00 per call, with the price in each description. Rate limit: 30 requests per 60 seconds shared across every route. Audit routes (rattler/cottonmouth/copperhead) can take minutes — raise --timeout. Demos, previews, per-service /feed pages, and subscription-management routes are deliberately not exposed.
